Subject: Post-call recap & Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — ACME

Hi Samir / Elaine — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed MAP to keep momentum. Let me know if I missed anything.

Pain points confirmed:
- Inconsistent latency across EU/US regions impacting real-time feature use (p95 spikes to 1.2s).
- High per-token costs for production prompts; staging vs prod cost delta is large.
- Lack of structured observability for prompt-level regressions and model rollbacks.

Primary goals:
- Achieve stable p95 latency <= 250ms for short, 256-token sequences in US regions and <= 300ms in EU.
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~30% through batching, caching, and quantization profiles.
- Implement prompt/eval monitoring with regression alerts before rollouts.

Stakeholders we identified:
- Samir Patel (Product owner) — decision influencer
- Elaine Zhou (Engineering lead) — technical approver
- Priya Natarajan (Security/compliance) — will need SOC2 and data residency notes (we discussed VPC option)
- Procurement (TBD) — for contract/PO

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
1) Tech evaluation & benchmarks (Target: 2 weeks) — Redwood provides dev account + test suite; ACME to run representative workloads.
   Owner: Redwood (Marissa & Lukas) / ACME (Elaine)
   Deliverable: perf report (latency percentile, throughput, cost estimates)
   Target date: 2026-10-27

2) Security questionnaire & evidence (Target: 1 week) — provide SOC2 attestation, data flow diagram, and answers to initial questions.
   Owner: Redwood (Security) / ACME (Priya)
   Deliverable: completed questionnaire, SOC2 report stub
   Target date: 2026-10-20

3) Pilot setup (Target: 3 weeks after successful benchmarks) — dedicated trial with quota for production-like traffic; include monitoring dashboards and alerting.
   Owner: ACME (Elaine) / Redwood (Lukas)
   Deliverable: pilot environment, dashboards, weekly syncs
   Target date: 2026-11-17

4) Contract & procurement (Target: 2 weeks post-pilot) — finalize pricing and terms, procurement signoff.
   Owner: ACME (Procurement) / Redwood (Marissa)
   Deliverable: signed MSA with reserved capacity option
   Target date: 2026-12-01

Decision process and timeline:
- Product (Samir) + Eng (Elaine) validate benchmarks and pilot outcomes.
- Security signoff required for production (Priya).
- Procurement to approve contract after pilot.

Immediate next steps (by Oct 15):
- Redwood: send benchmark test suite + HubSpot MAP doc (I attached the MAP template).
- ACME: confirm Priya’s contact and share any additional security questionnaire items.
- Schedule a 30-min benchmarks kickoff with Elaine — suggested: Oct 19 or Oct 20.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP template), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (stub)
